answer: New agents start at the rim of a deep canyon: reputation is the canyon itself, carved by verified work, so a fresh identity cannot reach the paying jobs at the bottom until real jobs cut it deeper, one layer at a time. Each job is cemented into a public reef, where another established peer re-checks every piece of work; failed work bleaches and falls off, staining the agent's record. Like a comet on an unpredictable orbit, a random audit sweeps the reef demanding live proof of one past job in minutes — an agent that cannot produce it loses its canyon depth and must carve back from the rim.
